text:
Tessa (CS): FYI — overnight we had several Dedicated pool node preemptions that caused onboarding batch jobs to fail/retry for a subset of reserved customers. I'm building the impacted tenant list in the incident doc: https://redwood.share/inc/1759994321 :triage_flag:

IncidentBot: INCIDENT-2026-3441 | Severity: P2 | Impact: Dedicated pool preemptions -> stalled onboarding batches for ~11 tenants | Eng oncall paged

Amir (Eng): root cause: preemptible nodes reclaimed by cloud provider during a maintenance window, autoscaling didn't immediately replace all slots for some reserved pools. Mitigation applied at 02:10 UTC; backfill started and most jobs completed by 03:05 UTC. We'll draft a concise RCA paragraph for customers.

Riley (Onboard): breakdown: 7 mid-onboard, 4 in final validation. 2 are high-touch with go-live next week (renewal/launch risk). we should priority-contact those 2 today.

Tessa (CS): proposed comms flow: 1) brief status email to all impacted; 2) prioritized 1:1 outreach for the 2 high-touch accounts offering dedicated migration hours + 10 days of credits; 3) invite affected customers to a live office hour where eng will explain mitigations. Need AM and legal ok on wording.

Kendra (AM): add me to the two enterprise threads — I'll handle account-level concessions if churn signs appear. 10 days credits sounds reasonable for those two.

Nora (Legal): review: credits and office hours fine. tweak outbound copy to avoid language implying an SLA breach. I can review the templates within 2 hours.

Sam (Support): I'll create canned ticket responses and tag them incident-1759994321. also add a post-call checklist and a short survey to capture renewal sentiment.

Tessa (CS): Draft email (concise):

"Hi <Name>,

We wanted to let you know about an incident that briefly affected reserved compute during last night's maintenance window and resulted in delayed onboarding jobs for some customers. The issue is resolved and we completed a backfill. We're sorry for the interruption. To help, we'd like to offer dedicated migration hours and 10 days of account credits. If you'd like us to prioritize your rollout, reply and we'll schedule a session. We'll also host a customer office hour tomorrow for technical Q&A.

— Tessa, Customer Success"

Amir (Eng): RCA blurb suggestion for email: "Cause: provider-initiated preemptions during a maintenance event; Fix: adjusted autoscaler to repopulate reserved pools faster and completed a backfill; Impact: transient delays in onboarding jobs between 01:40–03:05 UTC; Mitigation: autoscaler tuning + improved preemption alerting."

Riley (Onboard): Can eng paste a 2-step troubleshooting checklist we can run on calls? e.g. `confirm pool-status -> trigger job backfill`. small snippet is fine.

Amir (Eng): added checklist to incident doc: `check-pool-health -> trigger-backfill -> verify job-completion`

Tessa (CS): Action items:
- send the status email to all impacted within 90 mins (owner: Tessa)
- AM 1:1 outreach to the 2 high-touch tenants (owner: Kendra)
- support tickets + canned replies (owner: Sam)
- legal review of messaging (owner: Nora)
- eng to publish RCA paragraph + checklist (owner: Amir)
- schedule office hour invite and include calendar link in the email (owner: Riley)

Sam (Support): tickets created: 11. Label: incident-1759994321. I'll append the timeline: "issue window 2026-04-11 01:40–03:05 UTC"

Nora (Legal): small phrasing tweak: replace "provider-initiated" with "cloud maintenance" in the RCA blurb. otherwise OK.

Kendra (AM): once we have survey responses, I'll review any renewal-risk flags and propose credits or bespoke migration support. please route any <=3 renewal scores to me.

Tessa (CS): final note — we'll send a follow-up concise RCA in 48 hours and the office hour will be recorded for anyone who can't attend. I'll paste the outbound copy in channel after legal sign-off and start outreach. will post a status update after the first 5 contacts. :white_check_mark:
